also: you’re building castles in the air

terms.comment: Literally “you are building on sand”. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

phrases.latin: similis erit virō stultō, quī aedificāvit domum suam super arēnam
phrases.english: he will be like a foolish man who built his house upon the sand

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
